text: At its meeting held June 18 and 19, 2019, City Council amended the composition of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund Board to add one additional public member, and to allow one of its public members to be a non-Toronto resident that resides in the Greater Toronto and Hamilton area. The Civic Appointments Committee will recommend one public member to City Council for appointment to fill this position.

City Council on December 17 and 18, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint Andrew Dooner to the Toronto Atmospheric Fund Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term office ending December 17, 2023, and until a successor is appointed.
